notices.title: Scheduled Water Supply Maintenance
notices.content: Please note that the overhead water tank cleaning and maintenance will take place on Saturday from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Water supply will be temporarily suspended during this period. Kindly store adequate water in advance for essential needs. For any emergency requirements, contact the estate facility office.

notices.title: Annual General Body Meeting (AGM)
notices.content: The Annual General Body Meeting of Orchard Heights Apartments will be held on Sunday at 5:00 PM in the Clubhouse Community Hall. All residents and apartment owners are cordially requested to attend. The agenda includes presentation of the annual financial audit, security infrastructure upgrades, and clubhouse renovation proposals.

notices.title: Updated Visitor and Delivery Guidelines
notices.content: To enhance community security and streamline traffic, all delivery personnel (food, grocery, and e-commerce) must register at Gate 1 and obtain an entry pass. Residents are encouraged to pre-approve expected guests to minimize delays at the security checkpoint.

notices.title: Solar Streetlight Installation
notices.content: Installation of eco-friendly solar streetlights along Avenue 1 and 2 will commence this Monday. Please exercise caution when driving or walking in these zones during installation hours (9:00 AM - 4:00 PM).
